up: Retrieve compounds reported in document CHEMBL1125208. Return the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum clinical phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for each compound. Sort the results by ChEMBL ID. Join the docs table to compound_records using doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary using molregno, and finally to compound_structures using molregno to retrieve the canonical SMILES.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1125208' ORDER BY md.chembl_id
